title: Ware’s Christmas? A festive show for all the family
author: Ware Brass
html:
Ware Brass are well known locally for their themed shows, and this year they’re bringing the Drill Hall alive with the magical sound of Christmas!

Join your local brass band for a festive evening packed with Christmas songs, traditional carols and seasonal favourites. It’s a show for all the family, and everyone is welcome!

Keep your eyes peeled for a very special visitor… Father Christmas might just make an appearance!

The band would love you to join in the festive fun, so dig out your Christmas jumper, add some sparkle and tinsel, or come along in your favourite festive accessories!

With cabaret-style seating, you’re welcome to bring along some cold table snacks to enjoy with drinks from the licensed bar.

Whether you’re coming with family, meeting friends or simply looking to get into the Christmas spirit, Ware Brass promise a magical evening of music, merriment and festive cheer!

Get tickets here →
